text:
anya: Quick sync — customer asks for a Console flow that builds routing policies + exposes an API endpoint for infra teams. debating what the console MVP should do vs pushing them to API first.

devon: my leaning: API-first, tiny console wrapper. shipping full console surface is a lot of maintenance and slows iteration. but non-dev product teams expect one-click.

michael: can we be empirical? propose a short RICE calc for two options:
```
Option A (API-first + minimal console): Reach=6 Impact=6 Confidence=7 Effort=5 -> RICE ≈ 43
Option B (Full console features): Reach=7 Impact=8 Confidence=5 Effort=13 -> RICE ≈ 43
```
Numbers are fuzzy but it shows effort is the tiebreaker.

sara: strong +1 on effort being the killer. Full console means more QA, more support, more docs. Also we then need to version the console UX for Dedicated/Private which adds sync cost.

jamal: from CS: a few Enterprise customers (FinReg co, RetailCorp) asked specifically for a console wizard to hand to compliance teams. For them, perceived product completeness matters a lot — they won't adopt if it's API-only.

anya: here's a suggested compromise — phased console rollout with clear launch criteria.
Phase 1 (console-MVP): onboarding wizard, model pin + rollout UI, simple routing policy builder (templated), audit logs.
Phase 2: advanced routing rules, visual traffic-split controls, canned evals + quality monitoring.

devon: phased makes sense. Implementation detail: expose the same backend endpoints for console and API. Console just orchestrates existing APIs and ships templates. That keeps maintenance low and keeps API-first UX.

michael: alternative to RICE: Impact vs Effort matrix for stakeholders. Quick sketch:
- High impact / Low effort: onboarding wizard, model pin
- High impact / High effort: visual traffic-split, canned evals
- Low impact / Low effort: small UX polish
This helps justify shipping Phase 1 quickly.

sara: +1. We should also attach clear launch criteria for Phase 1:
- can create a routing policy and pin model version via Console and API
- audit logs for every action (VPC/Private friendly)
- QA checklist passed (cross-device, Dedicated infra)
- CS pilot (2 customers) signed up and validated

jamal: note: FinReg asks that console export an artifacts package (audit CSV + config) for their compliance team. If that's required we need to add it to Phase 1 or they won't pilot.

anya: ok — propose we add "export artifacts" to Phase 1 as a must-have for pilot customers. I'll update the RFC and do a proper RICE score with numbers from analytics (usage estimates, conversion). If folks agree, I'll schedule an async PRD + implementation slices.

devon: agree. small ask: include a feature flag so Dedicated/Private customers can toggle console features while we iterate.

michael: final ask — let's track developer friction metrics post-launch: time-to-first-successful-call (API) vs time-to-complete-onboarding (Console). that'll inform Phase 2.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: reminder — create RFC in #product-docs and assign reviewers (sara, jamal, devex).

sara: :thumbsup: adding reviewers now. thanks anya.

anya: thanks all — I'll ping the RFC thread in a few hours.
